beats.say: Three Indian states, shapes only. One is eighty-three times another's size.
beats.cap: 3 states · shapes only · one is ~83× another

beats.say: Shape one: second-largest state in the last census. Which is it?
Madhya Pradesh, ahead of Maharashtra by five hundred and thirty-nine square kilometres.
beats.cap: MADHYA PRADESH · ahead of Maharashtra by 539 km²

beats.say: Shape two gained four taluks from Travancore-Cochin in nineteen fifty-six. Which is it?
beats.cap: Shape 2 · 1956: four taluks moved in · Which state?

beats.say: Tamil Nadu, then called Madras. Those taluks became Kanyakumari district.
Shape three: so small, we had to zoom in. Which is it?
Goa, the smallest state by area in the last census.
Shape one is about eighty-three Goas. How many did you get?
